data.body: Validation data (7-day store mining, report in session files): BUDGET-EXHAUSTION-FALSE-UNMET is the top failure mode (10 incidents; observed exhaustions at request_limit 24-56 on 6-14-AC tickets), confirming the floor/scaling fix. Implementer cautions from the data: (1) validate bank persistence against REAL retry patterns — 5e53 and 266d retried at new --ref / refreshed worktrees, which would rotate a whole-tree key; the plan's file_impact-scoped blob fingerprint must be tested against exactly those flows (unrelated commits + worktree refresh must NOT invalidate). (2) dd41 retro: the budget lever was raised five times without spend data — size the new defaults against the runner's existing steps=N/limit logs (usage_report.py) and record observed headroom in the closing evidence. (3) Per-criterion fan-out was previously implemented and REMOVED for exploding token/wall-clock cost (12b7) — the child-traversal term must stay a budget-sizing input, never a fan-out execution model. (4) ZERO-BANKING-WEDGE is budget-independent (cf3c: 4x budget, 0 banks) — out of scope here, handled by 265a-9014-bd16-4623 (ERROR outcome).
